verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Intel's site serves a valid llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a short company-level description, so an agent could be pointed at it, but it's a generic corporate file rather than product-specific agent-oriented documentation for the Core Ultra 9 285K itself. Missing for 10: product-specific llms.txt/agent docs, evidence of structured agent-friendly spec pages for this SKU, and independent confirmation the file is actively maintained/comprehensive.
